$description: The Project Settings editor's two columns, drawn inside the pane: the section list and the section body. It draws no section — `panels/settings-pane.ts` keeps the registry, decides which section is current, and renders whichever one that is into the one empty `[part="body"]` island this document leaves for it (studio-ui-guidelines.md §9.4), because a section renderer may be a lit template or a mounted document and neither can share a container with this one. The list is a real vertical `tablist` rather than the column of `<button aria-current="page">` it replaces: a settings section is not a page and choosing one moves no location, so what the reader was owed was one tab stop, arrow keys down the column, and a body named by the entry that selected it.

style.$description: `.settings-doc`, `.settings-doc-nav`, `.settings-doc-content` (styles/panels.css) and `.settings-nav-item`, `.settings-nav-item:hover`, `.settings-nav-item.active`, `.settings-empty-state` (styles/overlays.css) — all seven go dead with this conversion and none is shared with a surface that is still lit. Four of them are DELETED rather than moved: the nav's own right rule and each row's hover fill, selected fill and weight are `jx-tabs[aria-orientation="vertical"]` and `jx-tab` respectively, and the two Spectrum greys they reached for (`--spectrum-gray-200`, `--spectrum-gray-300`) resolved only inside an `<sp-theme>` this pane never had — so both rows had been taking their hard-coded fallback since the editor moved out of the modal.

& [part=\"nav-item\"].$description: Full-bleed rows, which a tab is not by default: `jx-tab` centres its label and caps itself at 220px because a horizontal strip is a row of chips. In a 180px column the row IS the target, so the label goes to the leading edge and the cap comes off.

& [part=\"empty\"].$description: What the body says when the active section is registered by nobody — every section unregistering at once, which is a project closing while the editor is open. A blank column beside a list reads as a broken pane, so it says which it is.

children.$description: The island, and it stays empty: a settings section renders itself, into a host this document never writes into and never reads back (studio-ui-guidelines.md §9.4).
